struct Runtime;

impl Runtime {
    // REALTIME_POLICY_BEGIN
    fn execute_op() {}
    fn drain(&mut self) -> usize {
        let available = self.control.consumer.available_at_entry();
        let mut applied = 0;
        for _ in 0..available {
            let Ok(record) = self.control.consumer.try_pop() else {
                break;
            };
            debug_assert!(record.length() <= crate::ROUTE_RAMP_LENGTH_MAXIMUM);
            self.ramp = IndexedRamp::new(
                self.ramp.coefficients_at(self.position),
                record.target(),
                record.length(),
            );
            self.mute = record.mute();
            self.position = 0;
            applied += 1;
        }
        applied
    }
    // REALTIME_POLICY_END
}

// REALTIME_POLICY_BEGIN
fn reduce_plane() {}
// REALTIME_POLICY_END
// REALTIME_POLICY_BEGIN
fn compensation_delay_process() {}
// REALTIME_POLICY_END
// REALTIME_POLICY_BEGIN
fn track_delay_process() {}
// REALTIME_POLICY_END
// REALTIME_POLICY_BEGIN
fn publish_observations() {}
// REALTIME_POLICY_END
// REALTIME_POLICY_BEGIN
fn buffer_mut() {}
// REALTIME_POLICY_END
// REALTIME_POLICY_BEGIN
fn arena_members_fold_plane() {}
// REALTIME_POLICY_END
// REALTIME_POLICY_BEGIN
fn observe() {}
// REALTIME_POLICY_END
